units.source_text: 十二月二十过后，秋好皇后归宁六条院。

en.t: After the twentieth day of the twelfth month, Empress Akikonomu returned to Rokujo-in for a visit home.

units.source_text: 她要在这年终为义父源氏祝寿，特请奈良七大寺僧众诵经，布施布匹四千段；

en.t: At the end of the year she wished to celebrate the birthday of her adoptive father, Genji, and specially invited monks from the Seven Great Temples of Nara to recite sutras, giving four thousand lengths of cloth as alms.

units.source_text: 又请京都附近四十寺僧众诵经，布施绸绢四百匹。

en.t: She also invited monks from forty temples near Kyoto to recite sutras, and gave four hundred bolts of silk as offerings.

units.source_text: 秋好皇后感谢源氏养育之恩，欲乘此机会向他表示真诚的孝心。

en.t: Grateful to Genji for the kindness with which he had raised her, Empress Akikonomu wanted to use this occasion to show him her sincere filial devotion.

units.source_text: 又念父亲前皇太子及母亲六条妃子如果在世，一定也感谢他，所以她又怀着代父母祝寿之意。

en.t: She also thought that, if her father the late Crown Prince and her mother Lady Rokujo were still alive, they too would surely thank him, so she wished to offer these birthday congratulations on their behalf as well.

units.source_text: 但源氏连朝廷的祝寿也曾固辞，故秋好皇后不便铺张，只得将许多原定计划删去。

en.t: But since Genji had firmly declined even the court's birthday celebrations, Empress Akikonomu could not make the occasion too lavish and had to remove many of her original plans.

units.source_text: 源氏对她说道：“我查考前代事例，凡四十庆寿者，其余命大都不长。

en.t: Genji said to her, "When I looked into examples from earlier times, I found that those who celebrated their fortieth year generally did not live much longer afterward.

units.source_text: 故此次请勿过分铺张，以致轰动人世。

en.t: So please do not make this celebration overly splendid or stir up the whole world over it.

units.source_text: 如果我真能活满五十岁，那时再替我祝寿吧。”

en.t: If I truly manage to live to the full age of fifty, then you may celebrate my birthday for me."

units.source_text: 然而秋好皇后还是采用朝廷仪式，排场非常盛大。

en.t: Even so, Empress Akikonomu followed the court ceremonial form, and the celebration was exceedingly grand.
